In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
rye inclusion in diets for broilers may influence the immune system of the birds, but the effects on performance are limited.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the inclusion of rye in broiler diets affects the expression of genes involved with the regulation of cell growth, cell survival, and cell differentiation, which are involved in the maintenance of the gut barrier function, and that the inclusion of 5 or 10% of the rye in the broiler grower diet affected the expression of genes in the complement and co‐agulation pathway, which are involved with the eradication of invasive pathogens, and thus the innate immune response of broilers.
